import cProfile, json, pathlib, profile, sysconfig, torch
import torch._dynamo
torch.set_num_threads(2)
torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
expected = pathlib.Path(sysconfig.get_path("stdlib")) / "profile.py"
assert pathlib.Path(profile.__file__).resolve() == expected.resolve()
assert hasattr(profile, "run") and hasattr(cProfile, "Profile")
print(json.dumps({"profile_module": profile.__file__, "cprofile_module": cProfile.__file__, "torch_version": torch.__version__, "threads": torch.get_num_threads(), "deterministic_algorithms": torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled(), "new_model_calls": 0, "new_native_calls": 0}))
